analysis: Development continuation registered after the first full audit. Fixed 1024+1024 updates in every arm. In the mixed second phase, cue presence alternates by item and by the family repetition within each prototype, so every prototype/item occurs both with and without its cue. All final evaluations test every cue condition, including complete cue removal. Primary: whether mixed exposure preserves cue-free unseen-family performance at p8/p16, relative to abrupt removal, with p4 as the existing positive control. Report seedwise effects and even/odd item strata separately to check generality across items. A gain only on cued input is not rule transfer. Hidden/hidden repeats control for run drift. No universal scaling claim.
